description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin for embedding YouTube videos, including dialog UI, URL parsing, and embed code generation.

methods.name: ytVidId
methods.description: Extracts and returns the YouTube video ID from a URL.

methods.name: ytVidTime
methods.description: Extracts and returns the time parameter from a YouTube URL.

methods.name: hmsToSeconds
methods.description: Converts a time string in HH:MM:SS or MM:SS format to total seconds.

methods.name: secondsToHms
methods.description: Converts seconds into HH:MM:SS or MM:SS format.

methods.name: timeParamToSeconds
methods.description: Converts YouTube t-param time format (e.g., 1h2m3s) into seconds.

methods.name: secondsToTimeParam
methods.description: Converts seconds into YouTube t-param format.
